card.line: Jeshimon is a dry, empty wilderness region near the Dead Sea. In the Bible it marks where David hid from King Saul.

moments.title: The Ziphites tell Saul
moments.text: The Ziphites tell Saul that David is hiding in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah south of Jeshimon. They promise to hand David over to the king.

moments.title: Saul closes in on David
moments.text: David and his men are in the Wilderness of Maon, south of Jeshimon. Saul chases them around a mountain and is nearly upon them. Then a messenger says the Philistines have raided, and Saul turns away.

moments.title: Saul camps at Hachilah
moments.text: The Ziphites tell Saul again that David is on the hill of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon. Saul brings three thousand chosen men and camps beside the road there.

moments.title: David spares Saul
moments.text: David and Abishai go into the camp at night and find Saul asleep with his spear in the ground. Abishai wants to strike him, but David refuses to harm the LORD's anointed.
